name: Mark Takai
summary:
Kyle Mark Takai (July 1, 1967 – July 20, 2016) was an American politician and military officer who served as the U.S. representative  for Hawaii's 1st congressional district from 2015 until his death in 2016. A member of the Democratic Party, he previously served in the Hawaii House of Representatives from 1994 to 2014.
A native of Honolulu, Hawaii, Takai last served in the Hawaii Army National Guard as a lieutenant colonel and took part in Operation Iraqi Freedom in 2009, concurrent with his political career.
